decisions.reason: It strengthens the firm's identity-centric super-app offering for regulated customers by adding secure document storage that fits onboarding, compliance, and one-login convenience.
An identity-bound wallet directly matches the firm's payment, IAM, and secure ecosystem strategy and is valuable for financial, insurance, healthcare, and public-sector use cases.
NFC tag-based login is a narrower, more deployment-heavy authentication option that appears less central than the firm's software-platform priorities and likely faces limited broad-market adoption.
A secure payment and wallet framework is a core building block of the firm's integrated platform and supports reusable, compliance-friendly deployments across clients.
This is essentially the strategic centerpiece of the company because it enables the multi-service super apps and ecosystem platforms the firm is steering clients toward.
Application shielding reinforces the firm's security differentiation and can protect both its own platform apps and customer apps in regulated environments.
